Custom properties store values that can be reused with var(). They inherit by default unless
registered otherwise.
--brand වJගේ custom property එකකේ define කරලා var(--brand) වලින් භාවිත කරනවා. Theme
color එක එක තුනකින් Jවනස් කරන්න පුළුවන්. Scope එක අනුව child element වලට ඒ value එක
Change the brand color for an entire site or one component.
:root --brand: blue · button: blue .dark-card --brand: green · button: green

Read the diagram: 1. Root defines the default. 2. Descendants inherit the value. 3. A local override
changes only that subtree.
Root blue value එක සාමාන්‍ය button එකට ලුJබනවා. Dark card එJකේ override එක එහි button එක green
Expected result: Normal buttons are blue; buttons within .dark-card are green.
Interview question: Why use custom properties?

Answer: They centralize reusable values and allow contextual overrides without duplicating
rules.
Practice: Create a theme with brand and spacing variables.
